0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Bagnobrok is on the lookout for a widewalking adventurer.

24.original: Deliver the pungent pellets to Swipostik.

48.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... You are an adventurer, are you not? One who widewalks from place to place?

49.original: If you intend to widewalk to Many Fires, could you give this to mobbiefriend Swipostik? Bagnobrok forgot to overhand it last time he visited.

50.original: Naturally, your service shall receive its just reward. Just one warnyword: do not hold noseclose! Very stinkystuff!

51.original: ...What is the stinkystuff? It is better you don't know. Don't want to spoil Swipostik's surprise!

52.original: Pfffkohhh... A present from Bagnobrok, you say? I wonder what it could be...

53.original: Ah, what an uncredible aroma! Surewise, this is...yes, it is! The most farfamed of fancytastes that nomobbie can resist!

54.original: Why so wideeyes, adventurer? Did Bagnobrok not tell you what the present is? Swipostik could tell, but it would be better coming from Bagnobrok's wordhole. You should ask him!

55.original: No, adventurer, no! Swipostik will never lipslip Bagnobrok's secret!

56.original: You gave the present to Swipostik? Manythanks. Swipostik was very happyfeels about it, Bagnobrok trusts?

57.original: There isn't a Moblin around who doesn't love rot-tea, and Bagnobrok's rot-tea is very lipsmacky indeed. Put a pinch in a pot and boil it up, and the festergas is enough to make anymobbie's mask fill with eyewater!

58.original: Yes, rot-tea of Bagnobrok is very goodstuff. Bagnobrok knows exactly which fingerclippings and backscratchings make for the best brew.

59.original: Pfff? Why so bigeyes, adventurer? Do you want to try rot-tea of Bagnobrok for yourself? Sorry, but he gave it all to Swipostik! You will just have to wait until the next harvest!
